turns.label: Clinician

turns.text: OK. And when did you notice that the change?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah,

turns.text: OK um. Do you, are you able to lie down flat without experiencing shorter breath?

turns.text: OK, um it does it go away after you're done coughing,
